poems.line: Cláudio Manuel da Costa, Obras Poéticas de Glauceste Satúrnio (Coimbra, 1768; Garnier reprint, Rio de Janeiro, 1903), Sonetos, Tomo I, Portuguese Wikisource: sonnets I–III from the proofread 1903 pages in the original spelling; the remaining sonnets from the separately typed Wikisource pages, in modern Portuguese spelling. The Italian sonnets are not included (Coimbra: Wikisource (Portuguese), 1768)
